# reselling_startup_script (Resource)

A startup script stored in the account. It runs when a server is installed with `startup_script_id`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "reselling_startup_script" "docker" {
  name   = "docker"
  type   = "bash"
  script = <<-EOT
    #!/bin/bash
    apt-get update && apt-get install -y docker.io
  EOT
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name (max. 255 characters).
- `script` (String) Content of the script (max. 65000 characters).
- `type` (String) `bash` or `cloud_init`.

### Optional

- `is_default` (Boolean) Make this the default script of the account. The first script of an account becomes the default automatically. The flag can only be moved to another script, not removed.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import reselling_startup_script.docker <script_id>
```
